Load a package into a truck.desc: This action enables the truck to load a packagea at some location, the truck doesn't have load limit. For example, truck_1 loads package_1 at location_1.
Load a package into a truck.abstract_desc: This action enables the truck to load [object1] at [position1], the truck doesn't have load limit.

Unload a package from a truck.desc: This action enables the truck to unload a package at some location. For example, truck_1 unloads package_1 at location_2.
Unload a package from a truck.abstract_desc: This action enables the truck to unload [object1] at [position1].

Load a package into an uav.desc: This action enables the uav to load a package if the location is an airport. the uav doesn't have load limit. For example, uav loads package_1 at airport_1.
Load a package into an uav.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to load [object1] if [position1] is [state1]. The uav doesn't have load limit.

Unload a package from an uav.desc: This action enables the uav to unload a package if the location is an airport. For example, uav unloads package_1 at airport_2.
Unload a package from an uav.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to unload [object1] if [position1] is [state1].

Drive a truck from one location to anoth.desc: This action enables the truck to go from one location to another inside the same city. For example, truck_1 drives from location_1 to location_2 inside city_1.
Drive a truck from one location to anoth.abstract_desc: This action enables the truck to move from [object1]'s [position1] to [object1]'s [position2].

Fly an uav from one location to another.desc: This action enables the uav to fly from one airport to another airport across different cities. For example, uav flies from airport_1 in city_1 to airport_2 in city_2.
Fly an uav from one location to another.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [object1]'s [position1] to [object2]'s [position2].
